title: 숫자 속 소리 변화: 십육, 육십, 백만
objective: Read numbers like 십육 [심뉵], 육십 [육씹] and 백만 [뱅만] aloud.
summary: Learn three sound changes in numbers like 십육, 육십 and 백만.

task.title: Read numbers aloud
task.line: Use the rules on page 1 to choose or write how each number really sounds, then say it aloud.

words.meaning: one hundred six (106), here a room number

words.exampleMeaning: A million won is too expensive.

letters.as: Before 육, an n joins: 'nyuk'. Then ㅂ becomes m. (No n before other numbers: 십이 [시비], 십일 [시빌].)
Before m, k becomes ng and p becomes m.
After ㄱ or ㄹ, 십 turns tense, like 'ss' in 'hiss'.

exercises: Choose the right sound: ① 삼십육 ([삼시뷱] / [삼심뉵]) ② 팔십 ([팔십] / [팔씹]) ③ 칠백만 ([칠백만] / [칠뱅만])
Write how it sounds in [ ]: ① 육만 ② 칠십 ③ 이백만
Is an n sound added? Answer Yes or No: ① 사십육 ② 십오 ③ 구십육
Write the sound of the number in [ ]: ① 육십육 번 버스를 타요. ② 구백만 원이에요.
Write the number in Korean, then its sound in [ ]: ① 600,000 ② 86
answers: ① Yes [사심뉵] ② No [시보] ③ Yes [구심뉵]
